body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Best Bedding For Rabbits
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage.
-->

<section class="rcb-page alignfull" id="best-bedding-for-rabbits">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcb-page,
    .rcb-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcb-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcb-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rcb-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcb-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcb-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rcb-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcb-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rcb-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcb-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcb-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rcb-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcb-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcb-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcb-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcb-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcb-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcb-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcbFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay .rcb-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcb-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 540px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcb-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcb-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 6px 0 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcb-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rcb-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcb-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcb-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcb-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcb-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcb-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcb-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rcb-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcb-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcb-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcb-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcb-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcb-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcb-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rcb-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcb-section h2,
    .rcb-callout h2,
    .rcb-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcb-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcb-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcb-content {
      display: grid;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .rcb-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcb-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcb-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rcb-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rcb-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcb-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcb-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rcb-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcb-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcb-bedding-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcb-bedding-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 260px;
       padding: 34px 24px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcb-bedding-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

   .rcb-bedding-icon {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  font-size: 2rem;
}

    .rcb-bedding-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.32rem;
    }

    .rcb-bedding-card p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcb-mini-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-mini-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      color: #4b453c;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .rcb-mini-list li::before {
      content: "•";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcb-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcb-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .rcb-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcb-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rcb-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcb-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
    }

    .rcb-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcb-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcb-warning-card h2 {
      color: var(--rc-danger);
    }

    .rcb-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcb-avoid-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-avoid-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcb-avoid-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcb-cleaning {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcb-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcb-step {
      padding: 32px 24px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcb-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin: 6px 0 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcb-step h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.22rem;
    }

    .rcb-step p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rcb-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcb-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcb-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcb-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcb-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcb-side-card a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: #fff4d8;
    }

    .rcb-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcb-note strong {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
    }



    .rcb-shop {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.95), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcb-shop-box {
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcb-shop-intro {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: end;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .rcb-shop-intro h2 {
      margin: 10px 0 10px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 4.3rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcb-shop-intro p {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.04rem;
    }

    .rcb-product-slider {
      display: grid;
      grid-auto-flow: column;
      grid-auto-columns: minmax(245px, 31%);
      gap: 18px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      overscroll-behavior-inline: contain;
      scroll-snap-type: inline mandatory;
      padding: 4px 4px 18px;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    .rcb-product-card {
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: 210px auto;
      min-height: 100%;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.24s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease;
    }

    .rcb-product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 22px 52px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcb-product-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 210px;
      object-fit: cover;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcb-product-info {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 18px;
    }

    .rcb-product-info h3 {
      margin: 0;

        <div>

          <h2>Bedding materials to avoid</h2>
          <p>
            Some bedding materials can be harmful to rabbits and should not be used. Rabbits have sensitive noses, delicate digestive systems and may chew bedding, so safety matters.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rcb-avoid-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Cedar and untreated pine shavings</strong>
            These can contain aromatic oils that may irritate the respiratory system and are not suitable rabbit bedding choices.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Clay cat litter</strong>
            Clay-based litter can create dust and may cause digestive problems or blockages if eaten.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Scented bedding</strong>
            Artificial fragrances can irritate a rabbit’s sensitive nose and lungs. Choose unscented, natural bedding instead.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>

            </p>

            <p>Quick answers to common questions about choosing and using bedding for rabbits.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rcb-faq-list">
          <details class="rcb-faq-item">
            <summary>What is the safest bedding for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Paper-based bedding is one of the safest everyday choices because it is usually soft, absorbent and low in dust. Aspen shavings, hay and fleece liners can also work well depending on your setup and your rabbit’s chewing habits.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcb-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits use fleece bedding?</summary>
            <p>Yes, fleece can be useful for indoor rabbits, carriers and resting areas, but only where it is safe for that rabbit. Remove fleece straight away if your rabbit chews it, pulls threads or tries to eat fabric fibres.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcb-faq-item">
            <summary>Can I use hay as bedding for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Hay is safe for rabbits to sit on, dig in and nibble, and it can be useful in litter trays or nesting areas. It should still be kept clean and dry, and rabbits should always have fresh feeding hay available.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcb-faq-item">
            <summary>How often should rabbit bedding be changed?</summary>
            <p>Remove wet bedding every day, change litter areas every 2–3 days and deep clean the enclosure weekly. Rabbits that share an enclosure, urinate heavily or use soft fabric areas may need more frequent cleaning.</p>
          </details>

          <details class="rcb-faq-item">
            <summary>What bedding should rabbits avoid?</summary>
            <p>Avoid cedar, untreated pine shavings, clay cat litter and scented bedding. These can be dusty, irritating, unsafe if eaten or too strongly fragranced for a rabbit’s sensitive respiratory system.</p>
          </details>
